description: This source file defines metrics collection for execution components within a control plane service, using Prometheus client libraries to track metrics such as queue depth, worker activity, step durations, retries, waiters, and backpressure events.

methods.name: recordQueueDepth
methods.description: Updates the queue depth gauge with the current number of queued workflow steps.

methods.name: recordWaiterCount
methods.description: Sets the current number of synchronous waiter channels.

methods.name: recordWorkerAcquire
methods.description: Increments the count of active worker executions for a given agent (reserved for future use).

methods.name: recordWorkerRelease
methods.description: Decrements the count of active worker executions for a given agent (reserved for future use).

methods.name: observeStepDuration
methods.description: Records the duration of a workflow step execution, categorized by normalized status.

methods.name: incrementStepRetry
methods.description: Increments the retry counter for a specific agent.

methods.name: incrementBackpressure
methods.description: Increments the backpressure event counter with a specified reason.

methods.name: RecordGatewayBackpressure
methods.description: Public function to record backpressure events, intended for external callers such as HTTP handlers.

methods.name: normalizeAgentLabel
methods.description: Sanitizes and normalizes agent string labels for metrics labels.
